messages:
Alex C: T-minus 40 for the B-lane deploy. Quick confirmation thread — who is on smoke, who owns rollback, and any last-minute config flags?
Priya N: I can own smoke tests (api latency, 5xx rate, end-to-end happy path). I'll run the checklist at +5m after canary. :white_check_mark:
Samir: I'll be rollback owner. If errors spike >2% for 5m we roll back. I'll standby with the rollback playbook ready.
Jamie L: Infra watch here — nodes healthy, autoscaler steady. I flagged the feature-flag migration toggle (ff:enable_new_routing) — we should delay toggle flip until post-smoke unless Priya gives green.
Alex C: Good call. Plan: deploy canary 1% -> wait 2 mins -> smoke -> promote. If smoke passes, flip ff and continue. If smoke fails, rollback.
deploy-bot: Deploy window scheduled at 18:10 UTC. Canary target: 1% of traffic. Image: registry.redwood/infra:v3.8.2. Docs: https://go/release/4723
Priya N: Smoke checklist (I'll paste results inline):
- [ ] canary up (1 pod replaced)
- [ ] /health endpoint OK on canary
- [ ] 95th latency < 120ms
- [ ] 5xx rate < 0.5%
- [ ] integration queue length stable
- [ ] preview traffic sanity (sample request)
Alex C: Add these quick commands for rollback/smoke:
```
# smoke probe
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\"" https://api-staging.redwood/v1/health
# rollback (k8s)
kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-service -n prod --to-revision=3
# check rollout
kubectl rollout status deployment/api-service -n prod
```
Samir: I'll wait on the rollback command; but if we trigger I want the exact revision pinned. I'll annotate when ready.
ops-bot: Preflight checks: cluster nodes=ok, kv-cache hitrate=98%, pending migrations=1 (non-breaking). Attachments: none.
Jamie L: The pending migration is just the feature-flag metadata index build — will not block. I'll pause it if smoke shows degradation.
Priya N: Canary is up -> running probes now. Results so far: /health 200, avg latency 68ms, 5xx 0.0%. Holding for 2m then promote if stable. :thumbsup:
Alex C: All right — if Priya stays green at +2m we flip flag and promote canary. Samir, be ready to run rollback command if Priya posts fail. Everyone please +1 when you see green so I can proceed.
Samir: +1 (standing by)
Jamie L: +1
deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled in 2m unless any new objections.
Priya N: FINAL: smoke passed at +2m. All checks green. Promoting canary and flipping ff:enable_new_routing now. :rocket:
Alex C: Promotion in progress. Thanks team. I'll update runbook with timestamps.
Samir: Monitoring for 10m post-flip, will call rollback if error rate >1% sustained.
ops-bot: Post-deploy summary will be posted to #deploy-logs once rollout completes.
